app.title: 🎁 Wishlist
app.noGiftsDescription: Add the first gift to your wishlist!

add.title: New gift
add.name: Name
add.aiInputPlaceholder: Paste a link or describe the gift (e.g.: I want PlayStation 5 for $500 from Amazon)

reserve.title: Reserve gift
reserve.secretCodeHint: Save this code! You'll need it to cancel the reservation or mark as purchased.

unreserve.title: Cancel reservation
unreserve.prompt: Enter secret code to cancel reservation:

markPurchased.title: Mark as purchased
markPurchased.prompt: Enter secret code to mark as purchased:

delete.title: Delete gift
delete.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete the gift «{name}»?

auth.sessionExpired: Session expired, please log in again

invite.title: Invite registration
invite.subtitle: Create an account for your wishlist.
invite.name: Name
invite.required: Fill in name, address, and password
invite.passwordLength: Password must be at least 8 characters
invite.aiIncluded: AI access is enabled for this account

users.title: Whose wishlist?
users.subtitle: Open a public wishlist to choose and reserve a gift. Wishlist owners sign in from their own list to manage gifts.
users.noUsersDescription: No wishlists are available yet. New wishlists are added by invitation from the administrator.

privateHome.title: Gifts without guessing or duplicates
privateHome.subtitle: Collect wishes in one list and send the link to close people. Guests choose a gift, reserve it with a secret code, and never see other wishlists.
privateHome.guestHint: If you are a guest, just open the link you received.

cta.note: Wishlists are currently created by administrator invite. Guests open a list from a link without signing in.

inviteModal.title: How to get an invite
inviteModal.body: New wishlists are currently created through an administrator invite. This keeps the homepage from becoming a public directory of other people's lists.
inviteModal.ownerBody: Ask the administrator to create an invite. The invite link lets you create an account and collect your wishes in one list.
inviteModal.guestBody: You do not need to register. Open the link from the wishlist owner, choose a gift, and reserve it with a secret code.

ownerCard.title: Wishlist owner?
ownerCard.body: Log in with your username to open your list, add gifts, and copy the link for guests.

signedIn.title: You are signed in
signedIn.body: Open your wishlist to manage gifts and send the link to guests.

guests.title: For guests
guests.body: Open the link you received, choose a gift, and reserve it with a secret code.

owners.title: For owners
owners.body: After login, you can add gifts, edit details, and archive received gifts.

share.title: How to share
share.body: Open your wishlist and use the copy-link button in the page header.

linkPreview.label: Guest link example
linkPreview.body: The owner copies this kind of link from their wishlist and sends it to friends.

scene.title: One list instead of long chats
scene.body: The owner adds wishes, and guests use the link to choose and reserve gifts. The surprise still stays a surprise.
scene.note: The owner manages the list. Guests only receive the link.

why.title: So gifting is easier
why.body: Wishlist helps you collect ideas ahead of time, share them with close people, and show guests which gifts are already reserved.

noDuplicates.title: No duplicates
noDuplicates.body: Guests see what is reserved and avoid buying the same gift twice.

secret.title: Surprise preserved
secret.body: The owner manages the list, while guest reservation codes stay private.

simple.title: Everything together
simple.body: Links, prices, descriptions, images, and statuses stay in one place.

how.title: Three steps from wish to celebration

open.title: Owner collects wishes
open.body: Adds gifts, links, prices, images, and priorities.

reserve.title: Guest reserves
reserve.body: Chooses a gift and keeps a secret code for reservation changes.

celebrate.title: Guests gift calmly
celebrate.body: No messy chats and no one buys the same gift twice.

access.title: How to get access
access.ownerBody: Get an invite from the service administrator, sign in, and collect your wishes in one list.
access.guestTitle: Choose a gift as a guest
access.guestBody: Open the link from the wishlist owner and reserve a gift without creating an account.

footer.ownerAccess: Owners sign in with username and password.
footer.guestAccess: Guests open a wishlist from a direct link.

guestNote.title: For guests
guestNote.body: You can reserve a gift with your name and a secret code. Keep the code to cancel or mark the gift as purchased later.

givers.title: If you are choosing a gift
givers.body: Open the right wishlist, choose an available gift, reserve it, and keep your secret code.

owners.title: If this is your wishlist
owners.body: Sign in to add gifts, edit details, archive received gifts, and use AI autofill when access is enabled.

privacy.title: What stays private
privacy.body: Reservations are managed with secret codes. Owner actions require login, and new wishlists are added by invitation.

howItWorks.title: A shared place for gifts, reservations, and status

step1.title: Open a wishlist
step1.body: Pick a person above and browse their gift ideas, links, priorities, images, and prices.

step2.title: Reserve a gift
step2.body: Use your name and a secret code so the gift is not accidentally bought twice.

step3.title: Manage status
step3.body: Use the same secret code to cancel a reservation or mark the gift as purchased.

join.title: Want your own wishlist?
join.body: New wishlist owners can join by invitation. Contact the administrator if you want your own list here.

links.label: Everything in one place
links.text: Links, prices, descriptions, priorities, images, reservations, and gift status stay together.

ai.label: AI helps when enabled
ai.text: Owners with AI access can paste a product link or a short description and let the app fill gift details.
